vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --format vcf --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --fasta reference.fa --variant_class --uploaded_allele --mask_header_cache_path [--tab|--vcf|--json]
fasta: GRCh38 chromosome 21, the GRCh38-identifiers corpus's reference.fa.gz (its records' spans and its transcripts' spans with N elsewhere) decompressed, passed to both engines on every run; the region runs read every sequence record's reference allele from it, as the format's lookup_ref does
input: variants.region.txt: 23 hand-built regions at the sites of the GRCh38-identifiers corpus's records on chromosome 21 of the GRCh38-release116 cache, in position order: substitutions of one and two bases with the allele after a slash and after a colon, with the strand written 1, +1 and -1 and left out, in lower case and on the chr21 spelling; a two-for-three delins; deletions of one, 24 and 25 bases, one from the reverse strand; insertions of one, three and 55 bases, one from the reverse strand; and the structural words DUP, DEL, del and INS:ME:ALU over transcript spans; variants.vcf: the same 23 changes as VCF records sorted by position (the two at 14221107 fall the other way round), a reverse-strand region's twin written on the forward strand, named by their design

region.vep_command: vep -i variants.region.txt -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --format region --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --fasta reference.fa --variant_class --uploaded_allele --mask_header_cache_path [--tab|--vcf|--json]

region-guess.reference: the region set's expected_region, compared under format detection in place of --format region

generator: cache copied from tests/golden/116/GRCh38-identifiers (its json_cache and chr_synonyms.txt whole, the reference named from that corpus); variants.vcf and manifest.json by scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --release 116 --assembly GRCh38 --suite GRCh38-input-region=<reference>=<input> --k 100 --seed 1 --covers region-input-format --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --flag=--variant_class --flag=--uploaded_allele --flag=--mask_header_cache_path --fasta-name ../GRCh38-identifiers/reference.fa.gz; expected/ by one container run per format of the base invocation on the full Ensembl cache; build_golden_corpus.py flag-set (two sets) and classify (the base run); expected_region/ by one container run per format of the same image on the same cache under --format region with the FASTA, the four outputs gzipped and their sha256 recorded under flag_sets
